    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    Bishop.java Implements diagonal movement independently of Figure and is checked separately from the Figure array.
    ChessBoard
    ChessBoard.java Validates that enum-based columns and integer rows identify positions within the board.
    ChessColor
    ChessColor.java Defines the valid chess piece colors WHITE and BLACK.
    ChessMoveValidator
    ChessMoveValidator.java Controls input, prevents duplicate piece types, creates five Figure objects and a separate Bishop, checks their moves, and displays results.
    ChessPieceType
    ChessPieceType.java Defines the six supported chess piece types.
    Figure
    Figure.java Abstract superclass that stores shared piece attributes and implements IntFigure without providing movement behavior.
    IntBishop
    IntBishop.java Defines a diagonal movement contract independently of IntFigure.
    IntChessBoard
    IntChessBoard.java Defines the contract for validating chessboard coordinates.
    IntFigure
    IntFigure.java Defines the movement contract used by the Figure hierarchy.
    InvalidCoordinateException
    InvalidCoordinateException.java Represents a null column or row outside the board boundaries.
    InvalidMoveException
    InvalidMoveException.java Represents a movement pattern that is invalid for the selected piece.
    InvalidPieceException
    InvalidPieceException.java Represents an invalid piece name or unsupported piece type.
    King
    King.java Extends Queen and restricts straight and diagonal movement to one square.
    Knight
    Knight.java Represents a knight that moves in an L-shaped pattern.
    LocationX
    LocationX.java Defines the valid chessboard columns A through H.
    Pawn
    Pawn.java Represents a pawn that moves one square forward according to its color.
    Queen
    Queen.java Extends Rook and implements IntBishop to combine straight and diagonal movement.
    Rook
    Rook.java Represents a rook that moves horizontally or vertically to a different square.
